summary: Persona packages get smaller: the orchestrator now embeds `package.diff` (generated files collapsed) instead of `diff.patch`, and every lens but product-flow gets the spec without its Tasks and Hints. `package_violations` checks the written `<persona>.in.md` files, and `persist --strict` runs it so a package that broke the rules cannot reach REVIEW.md.
defect: `persist --strict` now applies a packaging rule to the `<persona>.in.md` files already on disk. Every review directory written before this change embedded `diff.patch` and the full spec, so re-persisting one (the documented re-run after a partial failure) fails on packaging unrelated to its findings, after the review cost is spent. The check belongs at dispatch, or only where `package.diff` exists.
